packages.label_en: Ten Psalms Chapters and Ten Types of Melody
packages.reason: The ten chapters of Psalms and the ten types of melody are two expressions of the same corrective instrument of holiness. The Torah explicitly equates them structurally: the ten Psalm chapters correspond to (כנגד) the ten types of melody enumerated in Tehillim. Both are the same holy power of song that opposes and nullifies the klipa of nocturnal emission — they are not cause-and-effect but two names for the same tikkun-instrument, one describing its external form (chapters of a book) and one its inner musical essence (types of melody).
